_meta.title: Soulvizier Classic build45 - Mastery Skill Unlock-Alignment Audit
_meta.method: read-only arz_patcher replay; no game, no build
_meta.namespaces: m1-8 = records\ingameui\player skills\mastery N ; m9 = records\xpack\ui\skills\mastery 9 (build45 has NO ingameui m9 and NO xpack m1-8 twins; effective set is unambiguous)

field_calibration.primary_field_semantics: skillTier is the engine tier index (1..7); the tier-unlock mastery-points threshold is pointThreshold(tier)=1/4/10/16/24/32/40. In vanilla skillTier equals the bitmapPositionY row for 142/142 tiered displayed skills (0 violations) across all 9 masteries - this is the 'aligned by construction' invariant and proves skillTier (not skillMasteryLevelRequired) is the row-unlock gate.
field_calibration.secondary_field_semantics: an additional per-skill floor. In vanilla it does NOT equal the row threshold (equal for only 18/180 displayed skills; EARLY/below for 109, LATE/above for 14, absent for 39). battlestandard(tier3,req0) unlocks at 10 and ancestralhorn(tier6,req30) unlocks at 32 prove req-alone is refuted and the tier threshold binds. It is engine-read though (not vestigial): the b70 throwingknife fix raised req 5->24 to match its tier-5/row-5 placement, so the effective gate is max(tier_threshold,req).

vanilla_baseline.note: the 14 vanilla req>row-threshold cases (e.g. crosscut req24 on row4, ensnare_barbednetting req24 on row3) are the 'even vanilla misaligns' baseline - modifier/leaf chain-slots where the row shows topology and req is the true gate; they are by-construction, not defects.
